title: Quick-fix Korean Springy Batter Pancake
description: A simple and quick Korean-style pancake with a springy texture made from English muffins, inspired by the Korean hwajeon form without using eggs.

ingredients.name: Korean chili flakes
ingredients.notes: Gochugaru or Korean chili flakes add a spicy kick

ingredients.name: Grated garlic
ingredients.notes: Minced garlic adds depth of flavor

ingredients.name: Grated ginger
ingredients.notes: Grated ginger adds warmth and spice

ingredients.name: Scallions
ingredients.notes: Chopped scallions add a fresh flavor

instructions: Heat sesame oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat
Add grated garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant
Add Korean chili flakes and cook for another minute, until fragrant
Cut English muffins into quarters and add to the pan, pressing down gently with a spatula
Cook for 3-4 minutes, until the bottom is golden brown
Flip the English muffins over and cook for another 3-4 minutes, until the other side is golden brown
Garnish with toasted sesame seeds and chopped scallions
